import type { Photo } from '../stores/photos'

export type PostExtraForm = {
  rectifyMeasure?: unknown
  rectifyDeadline?: unknown
  rectifyState?: unknown
  rectifyUser?: unknown

export function validatePostExtraForm(form: PostExtraForm): string | null {
  if (!String(form.rectifyMeasure ?? '').trim()) return '请输入整改措施'
  if (!String(form.rectifyDeadline ?? '').trim()) return '请选择整改期限'
  if (!String(form.rectifyState ?? '').trim()) return '请选择整改状态'
  if (!String(form.rectifyUser ?? '').trim()) return '请输入整改责任人'
  const ph = (form.photos ?? []) as Photo[]
  if (!Array.isArray(ph) || !ph.length) return '请上传现场照片'
  if (ph.length > 6 || ph.some(p => p?.status !== 'done' || !p.url)) return '照片尚未保存成功，请重试或删除；最多6张'
  return null
}
